limitations: transparency_classification: No classification applies without prices.

sources.title: GraphCode README (v0.1.84)
sources.locator: How it works; Install; Using it; Parts; Workspaces; Credits & license
sources.finding: macOS 15+ Apple Silicon app, daemon and CLI that run Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex, OpenCode and pi sessions as live terminals (zmx) connected by hand-off, message and spawn edges; loop types turn, goal, time and composite; local and SSH projects; FSL-1.1-MIT.

sources.title: Licensing
sources.finding: GraphcodeKit and graphcode-cli are MIT; the app and graphcoded daemon are under the Functional Source License 1.1 with an MIT future license converting two years after each release.

sources.title: GraphcodeKit license
sources.finding: MIT license for the shared kit.

sources.title: CLI command parser
sources.locator: cases: projects, workspaces, status, usage, sessions, reap, graph, node, mail, edge
sources.finding: CLI covers projects, status, usage, sessions, reap, graph, node create/send/stop/restart/delete/pilot/arm/update/memo/promote/done/refine/export/import, mail and edge operations against the daemon.

sources.title: Backend kinds
sources.finding: claudeCode, copilotCLI, codex, openCode, pi and GraphCode Nod (own chat-native agent).

sources.title: Backend capabilities
sources.finding: Per-backend capability flags constrain which loop types and edge kinds a backend can host.

sources.title: GraphCode Nod runtime
sources.finding: Own chat-native agent on the Claude Agent SDK or GitHub Copilot SDK with a permission gate, goal evaluator and a graphcode MCP server exposing siblings, edges and mailroom.

sources.title: Cycle guard
sources.finding: Edges that close a cycle re-fire only with a bounded guard (count, shell predicate or metric).

sources.title: Usage sample
sources.finding: Token and cost figures are only what backend hooks report; absent values show as not reported rather than zero.

sources.title: Worktree binding
sources.finding: A loop node can be bound to a git worktree with repository path, worktree path and branch.

sources.title: Worktree landing detection
sources.finding: Decides whether a worktree branch already landed on the default branch for safe cleanup.

sources.title: Remote projects
sources.finding: Projects can live on a remote host over SSH (key auth, zmx on the server) while this Mac steers them; GitHub Codespaces are dialled via gh codespace ssh.

sources.title: Update client
sources.finding: Checks GitHub releases for a newer app and installs through UpdateInstallClient; no other first-party endpoint found.

sources.title: Windows shell
sources.finding: Windows port is a preview shell on the same daemon; releases 0.1.84-windows.betaN are described as invitation-only, unsigned preview.

sources.title: Settings model
sources.locator: new-loop backend, preferred versions, daemon heartbeat
sources.finding: Settings include the default backend for new loops, preferred Copilot CLI version and an experimental daemon heartbeat.

sources.title: Loop node model
sources.locator: loop types, goal spec, worktreeBinding, usage, metricHistory
sources.finding: A node carries prompt, backend, type, goal check, worktree binding, usage and metric history.

sources.title: Comparison page (first-party)
sources.finding: First-party comparison states GraphCode is free with no paid tier and sources competitor cells.

sources.title: Shortcuts
sources.finding: Keyboard shortcuts for jumping between loops (⌘K), reviewing the attention queue (⌘⇧R), workspaces and terminals.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 158 stars, license NOASSERTION in the API (repository LICENSE is FSL-1.1-MIT plus MIT directories), homepage https://graphcode.app, pushed 2026-11-13, 131 open issues; releases include v0.1.84 and 0.1.84-windows.beta32.

sources.title: GitHub releases
sources.finding: Latest stable v0.1.84 published 2026-11-06 with graphcode-macos-arm64.dmg; Windows betas 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-09 are invitation-only unsigned previews.

sources.title: GraphCode website
sources.finding: Product site for macOS 15+ Apple Silicon, FSL-1.1-MIT, free; includes an email signup for release news.

sources.title: Bounded search: clients and platforms
sources.locator: ls graphcode graphcode-cli graphcode-windows; rg -i "ios|android|web ui|http server|electron|tauri" over graphcode*, GraphcodeKit
sources.finding: Clients are the SwiftUI macOS app, the Swift CLI and a preview Zig/Win32 shell; no iOS, Android, browser or editor client.

sources.title: Bounded search: webhooks and external events
sources.locator: rg -i "webhook|cron|crontab|fsevents|github event" over GraphcodeKit, graphcoded, graphcode
sources.finding: No webhook or external-event trigger; time-based loops use the agent own /loop skill or the experimental daemon heartbeat.

sources.title: Bounded search: accounts, roles, SSO, sharing
sources.finding: No accounts, roles, sharing or SSO; one local user per workspace and daemon socket.

sources.title: Bounded search: pull requests and merges
sources.locator: rg -i "gh pr create|createPullRequest|pull request|git merge" over graphcode/Sources, GraphcodeKit
sources.finding: No PR creation; GitClient handles worktree create/list/remove and landing detection; PR text appears only in contributor docs and a summary board label.

sources.title: Bounded search: hosted execution and isolation
sources.finding: No hosted GraphCode service and no container or VM isolation; remote execution is the user own SSH host or Codespace.

sources.title: Bounded search: telemetry
sources.locator: rg -i "telemetry|analytics|posthog|sentry|mixpanel|aptabase" over graphcode, GraphcodeKit, graphcoded, NodRuntime
sources.finding: No analytics SDK or product telemetry endpoint found; hits are unrelated naming; outbound calls are GitHub releases, Copilot device flow and the user chosen agent CLIs and SDKs.

sources.title: Bounded search: issue tracker
sources.finding: No issue tracker; loops and graphs are the work records.
